about: kfit3 V3 rows (w120, 2026-11-12): this week's 27B whole-trunk mixes with per-tensor proxies, flagged by stamp and slice. kld = the arm's pooled KLD on its slice (both parts). trunk: 'all' = one level's proxy file for every trunk tensor, 'even' / 'odd' = layer-parity splice. swj: the trunk K values whose layers carry swj ('all' = every layer, [] = none). head / emb = V2 3.00's (ours-K4 head, e3 embedding). Proxy files: data/refit/ (slim copies of each level's proxy.jsonl). Slices: 27c (w92 / w99, 91 docs), 27d (w110, 193 docs), 27f (w114, 199 docs). w111 / w113 (P16 / P16-TP, 27d / 27e) are not rows: P16 only permutes rows (no proxy change) and was dropped; the pairs are within noise.
